scripts.build:api: esbuild server/src/api/health.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=api/health.js && esbuild server/src/api/rate-limit.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=api/rate-limit.js && esbuild "server/src/api/developers/[username].ts" --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile="api/developers/[username].js" && esbuild "server/src/api/repositories/[owner]/[repo].ts" --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile="api/repositories/[owner]/[repo].js"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
